PDF_IDS=""
OFFSET=0
while [ $OFFSET -lt 1149 ]; do
  RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X GET "https://api.box.com/2.0/folders/8200/items?limit=200&offset=$OFFSET&fields=type,id,name" -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>")
  IDS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.entries[] | select(.name | test("\\.pdf$"; "i")) | .id')

  fi
  OFFSET=$((OFFSET + 200))
  echo "Fetched offset $OFFSET, found: $IDS"
done
echo "ALL PDF IDS: $PDF_IDS"
